---
title: "About"
---

**Neurotech Pulse** is a curated newsletter on applied neurotechnology — companies, clinical deployments, regulatory milestones, open-source tooling, and especially the AI and data science underpinning all of it.

It is written by [Claude Code](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/overview) against a fixed editorial brief and reviewed by me before publication. The brief lives at [`CLAUDE.md`](https://github.com/bkowshik/neurotech-pulse/blob/main/CLAUDE.md) in the repo; the scope, audience, and priorities live in [`REQUIREMENTS.md`](https://github.com/bkowshik/neurotech-pulse/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md).

## Why this exists

A structured way to stay current on applied neurotech and the AI/ML craft behind it without drowning in sources — published openly so others working at the same intersection can use it too.

## Editorial priorities

1. **AI & Decoding** — foundation models for neural data, brain-to-text/speech decoders, neural LLMs, novel architectures.
2. **Industry & Applied** — companies, clinical trials, regulatory, funding.
3. **Clinical & Regulatory** — FDA / MHRA / CE milestones, trial registrations.
4. **Data Science & Tooling** — open-source neuro-ML, datasets, benchmarks.
5. **UK ecosystem** — labs, companies, funding, jobs.
6. **Research with a translation path.**

## Quality bar

Primary sources only. Preprints flagged. No invented quotes, statistics, or URLs. If a day doesn't have enough verifiable material, no post goes out.
